7. Pembatalan

JADUAL

AKTA ORGANISASI ANTARABANGSA (KEISTIMEWAAN DAN KEKEBALAN) 1992

PERATURAN-PERATURAN AGENSI-AGENSI KHUSUS (KEISTIMEWAAN DAN

KEKEBALAN) 2012

PADA menjalankan kuasa yang diberikan oleh subseksyen 3(1) dan 4(1), dan

seksyen 6B dan 11 Akta Organisasi Antarabangsa (Keistimewaan dan Kekebalan)

1992 [Akta 485], Menteri, dengan persetujuan Menteri Kewangan, membuat peraturanperaturan yang berikut:

Nama

1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan AgensiAgensi Khusus (Keistimewaan dan Kekebalan) 2012.

Tafsiran

2. Dalam Peraturan-Peraturan ini, melainkan jika konteksnya menghendaki makna

yang lain—

"agensi-agensi khusus" ertinya organisasi yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual; dan

"pegawai" ertinya seseorang pegawai agensi khusus, selain pegawai tempatan

yang diambil bekerja.

Pengisytiharan Agensi-agensi Khusus sebagai organisasi antarabangsa

3. Agensi-agensi khusus diisytiharkan sebagai organisasi antarabangsa.

Keperibadian juridikal

4. Agensi-agensi khusus hendaklah mempunyai keperibadian juridikal dan apa-apa

keupayaan di sisi undang-undang sebagaimana yang perlu bagi penjalanan kuasanya

dan pelaksanaan fungsinya.

Keistimewaan dan kekebalan

5. Agensi-agensi khusus dan wakil anggota, pegawai dan pakar dalam misinya

hendaklah mempunyai semua atau mana-mana keistimewaan dan kekebalan yang

dinyatakan dalam Jadual Kelapan kepada Akta.

Penepian

6. (1) Agensi-agensi khusus hendaklah mempunyai hak dan kewajipan untuk

mengetepikan kekebalan yang diberikan kepada pegawai atau mana-mana orang yang

sedang melaksanakan apa-apa misi bagi pihak agensi khusus jika, pada pendapatnya,

kekebalan itu akan menghalang perjalanan keadilan dan kekebalan itu boleh

diketepikan tanpa menjejaskan kepentingan agensi khusus itu.

(2) Sesuatu Negara Anggota atau ketua eksekutif suatu organisasi

antarabangsa atau seberang laut hendaklah mempunyai hak dan kewajipan untuk

mengetepikan kekebalan yang diberikan kepada mana-mana orang yang hadir di

mesyuarat yang diadakan oleh agensi khusus jika, pada pendapat Negara Anggota atau

ketua eksekutif suatu organisasi antarabangsa atau seberang laut itu, kekebalan itu

akan menghalang perjalanan keadilan dan kekebalan itu boleh diketepikan tanpa

menjejaskan maksud yang baginya kekebalan itu diberikan.

Pembatalan

7. Peraturan-Peraturan Agensi Khusus (Keistimewaan dan Kekebalan) 2009

[P.U. (A) 249/2009] dibatalkan.

SPECIALIZED AGENCIES (PRIVILEGES AND IMMUNITIES) REGULATIONS 2012

____________________

ARRANGEMENT OF REGULATIONS

____________________

Regulation

1. Citation

2. Interpretation

3. Declaration of the Specialized Agencies as international organizations

4. Juridical personality

5. Privileges and immunities

6. Waiver

7. Revocation

SCHEDULE

INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS (PRIVILEGES AND IMMUNITIES) ACT 1992

SPECIALIZED AGENCIES (PRIVILEGES AND IMMUNITIES) REGULATIONS 2012

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsections 3(1) and 4(1), and sections 6B and

11 of the International Organizations (Privileges and Immunities) Act 1992 [Act 485],

the Minister, with the concurrence of the Minister of Finance, makes the following

regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Specialized Agencies (Privileges and

Immunities) Regulations 2012.

Interpretation

2. In these Regulations, unless the context otherwise requires—

"specialized agencies" means the organizations specified in the Schedule; and

"official" means an officer of a specialized agency, other than an officer who is

engaged locally.

Declaration of the Specialized Agencies as international organizations

3. The specialized agencies are declared as international organizations.

Juridical personality

4. The specialized agencies shall have juridical personality and such legal capacities

as may be necessary for the exercise of their powers and the performance of their

functions.

Privileges and immunities

5. The specialized agencies and their representatives of members, officials and

experts on mission shall have all or any of the privileges and immunities specified in the

Eighth Schedule to the Act.

Waiver

6. (1) Specialized agencies shall have the right and duty to waive the immunities

conferred on an official or any person who is performing any mission on behalf of the

specialized agency where, in their opinion, the immunities would impede the course of

justice and the immunities can be waived without prejudicing the interests of the

specialized agency.

(2) A Member State or the executive head of an international or overseas

organization shall have the right and duty to waive the immunities conferred on any

person who is in attendance at meetings convened by the specialized agency where, in

the opinion of the Member State or the executive head of an international or overseas

organization, the immunities would impede the course of justice and the immunities can

be waived without prejudicing the purposes for which they were conferred.

Revocation

7. Specialized Agencies (Privileges and Immunities) Regulations 2009

[P.U. (A) 249/2009] is revoked.
